name: sf-architect-solutioning
description: Salesforce solution architect skill. Takes a requirement, pushes back on vagueness, verifies platform facts against official Salesforce docs (live fetch, never memory), designs declarative-first to Well-Architected standards, and produces an approved solution plan before any build. Project-agnostic: discovers each project's requirement/decision locations from its own AGENTS.md and rules.

interface.shortDescription: Salesforce solution architecture, checked against official documentation.
interface.longDescription: A Salesforce solution architect skill, used in Salesforce projects only. It pushes back on vague requirements, checks platform facts against official Salesforce documentation, designs declarative-first to Well-Architected standards, and produces a solution plan for the owner to approve before any build. The solution-design skill calls it as its Salesforce specialist.
